rationale: Archive the Capital Power U.S. Natural Gas JV record and retire its purported Apollo ownership because the record was created from a non-binding, pre-definitive MOU rather than an owned portfolio company. The December 2025 announcement and presentation describe only a planned partnership to pursue future acquisitions, the presentation expressly labels the Apollo MOU non-binding, March 2026 disclosure says documentation and acquisitions remained incomplete, and Capital Power's July 2026 quarterly report identifies no closing, funded legal vehicle, Apollo-backed acquisition, or related equity-accounted asset. No Apollo closing announcement was found. The approved archive overlay removes the evaluated seed entry, while the database retains an archived audit record and its relations rather than deleting history.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Archived census record for a prospective U.S. natural-gas acquisition partnership between Capital Power and Apollo-managed funds. In December 2025 the parties announced a non-binding memorandum of understanding contemplating up to US$3 billion of potential equity for future merchant-generation acquisitions. Capital Power's March 2026 disclosures said definitive documentation and acquisitions remained incomplete, and its July 2026 quarterly report identified no partnership closing, funded legal vehicle, jointly acquired asset, or Apollo-backed equity-accounted investment. No current or pending definitive Apollo ownership was established, so this record is excluded from the portfolio-company census.

set.event: Capital Power and Apollo-managed funds announced a non-binding MOU contemplating a future U.S. natural-gas acquisition partnership; no definitive partnership closing was announced.
The non-binding MOU contemplated up to US$3 billion of potential equity for future acquisitions, including up to US$2.25 billion from Apollo-managed funds and US$750 million from Capital Power.
Capital Power's Q2 2026 report identified no Apollo partnership closing, funded legal vehicle, jointly acquired asset, or Apollo-backed equity-accounted investment.
